title: dfilter: Fix parsing OID literal values
description:
Fix expressions such as `snmp.name == 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0`. We must not
parse the right hand side like an invalid protocol field.

notes.body: This works for me. Probably going to increase the development burden for dfilter since this isn't a straight cherry-pick. Hopefully there won't be a lot of backports.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -41,6 +41,8 @@ The following bugs have been fixed:
 //* cveidlink:2014-2486[]
 //* Wireshark grabs your ID at 3 am, goes to Waffle House, and insults people.
 
+* Fixed parsing display filter expressions containing literal OID values, e.g. `snmp.name == 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0`.
+
 === New and Updated Features
 
 There are no new or updated features in this release.
